Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action sequence. Lock referenced identities, clothing, proportions and rigid handmade masks, including fixed eye openings. All humans are masked. Hard cuts only at listed times. Unless labelled LOCKED, camera stays physically moving: handheld drift, late reframing, foreground obstruction and brief focus slips that recover essential action. Broken framing never means broken armor, damaged sets or glitch effects. No slow motion, arbitrary orbit, zoom or exposure pumping. Written lighting overrides reference exposure. Generate diegetic sound only; poetry is added in post. NO DIALOGUE, NARRATION OR MUSIC. Fixed world anchors survive every cut. Screen directions belong only to each named angle. Off-camera actors retain their marks. Body facing and eyeline are separate; no accidental looks into camera.
Zahhak retains his referenced 178 cm body, support hand and weak-leg side. Every step: plant staff, transfer weight, weaker leg follows. Turns: staff, torso, then head. No brisk or normal walking. Lock the supplied dream reference's exact count of five to ten natural black single-headed snakes across all blocks; independent living movement on shoulders, neck, back and torso continues even while he is still. No dragons or rigid snakes.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
One night hall: NORTH upper throne; middle-level rim; central square exactly THREE shallow steps lower, accessed at NORTH. WEST camera aisle; SOUTH/EAST guard entrances. NORTH/WEST/SOUTHWEST dark bays are parts of this hall, not separate sets. Iranian-inspired stone, rounded openings, engineered practical lamps. Low neutral wall lights and faint cold high-opening spill stay fixed. Upper landing slightly brighter than recessed floor. No fog, aura or magical transitions. New angles discover bodies already in shadow. Reality characters never see or react to the prophecy tableaux.

PLAN 07 | BLOCKING AND SHOTS
START STATE AND BLOCKING
Zahhak on the lower floor below P2 at SOUTHWEST rim. P1 at SOUTH, P3 farther WEST; Zirak behind P2. Arnavaz remains EAST. Staff remains in its established support hand. He can grip P2's hanging outer robe with his free hand while keeping support. Off-screen cast retain these marks. No unlisted entrance or exit.
SHOT 07-01 | 0s–4s | 4 SECONDS
50mm close from WEST on Zahhak's free hand closing on P2's outer robe at the rim. Cloth tightens, P2 bends forward rather than falling into the recess. Camera shifts backward with the pull; focus briefly clings to cloth then recovers the trembling fingers.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: Hand and robe detail at southwest rim; P2 stays above Zahhak. Staff remains on lower floor in support hand.
SHOT 07-02 | 4s–8s | 4 SECONDS
35mm from SOUTHEAST of the pair looking northwest: P2 upper-left on the rim, Zahhak lower-right on the floor, facing one another in opposing profiles. P2 looks away with shallow breathing. Slide slightly on this same side of the axis to discover Zahhak's searching eye under the mask. He wants an answer; no spoken words.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: Use SOUTHEAST of the pair looking northwest: P2 upper-left, Zahhak lower-right, opposing profiles. Slide without crossing their axis.

PLAN 07 | SHOTS AND HANDOFF
SHOT 07-03 | 8s–10s | 2 SECONDS
65mm moving view through a gap between P1/P2 from SOUTH rim. Zirak behind them lifts his hand halfway, inhales and lowers it again. His body remains afraid, no heroic pose.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: Zirak remains behind P2 at southwest; P1 and P2 frame him, never swap identities.
SHOT 07-04 | 10s–13s | 3 SECONDS
28mm close side view at lower-floor height from WEST. Zahhak releases the robe, braces his free palm against the stone rim, lifts the staff only a short distance and strikes it once onto the floor. His balance wavers, then he reloads weight onto the planted staff. Camera jolts with the short impact; no fast walking.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: Zahhak releases P2 before staff strike. P2 stays on middle level, recovering his own balance.
SHOT 07-05 | 13s–15s | 2 SECONDS
40mm from SOUTHWEST rim, tracking P3's retreat half a step. Zahhak below turns toward him: staff repositions, torso follows, head turns last. P3's robe brushes across the foreground, concealing part of the action without hiding its direction.
FRAME / EYELINE / CONTINUITY: P3 retreats WEST away from edge; Zahhak turns WEST from the southwest lower floor and takes one supported step toward him.
END STATE AND EDIT
Zahhak now faces P3 at WEST rim, supported by his staff. P2 is released and steadies himself. Zirak has not committed yet. Arnavaz stays at EAST rim; guards hold southeast/southwest outer posts. No one crosses to another level.
SOUND
Close uneven breathing, fabric pressure, footsteps at the specified level, staff contacts on stone, subtle scales against clothing, restrained practical-lamp hum and hall resonance. Perspective follows camera distance. No intelligible voices. No sound of any omitted strike or death. Maintain room tone across dream/reality cuts; no magical whoosh. Final cut to black only where specified.
NO DIALOGUE. NO NARRATION. NO MUSIC.
